newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mubarak back home after Gulf tour.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak back home after Gulf tour.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak returned home on Sunday after a brief visit to the Gulf, airport sources said.
Mubarak on Friday stopped over in Kuwait and later Saudi Arabia for talks with leaders there on Arab relations and the stalled Middle East peace process.
Israel's decision last month to begin building a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem angered many in the Arab world and brought the peace process to a halt.
Mubarak told Egyptian television on Friday he opposed holding an Arab summit at present because it could complicate peace talks by taking collective measures against Israel.
But a mini-summit could be held "for the sake of peace and not to take decisions," he added.
